shared_elements: curled or stylized hair and beards
low-relief carved figures on a wall surface
animals depicted in profile (in A only, so not shared)
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in strict profile wearing long fringed garments carved in low relief, with hand/arm gestures and file-like alignment, which is a fairly specific shared convention. However A is a wide architectural view combining a lion-attacking-bull group, columns and terraces with tiny processional figures, while B shows two overlapping large-scale figures filling the field, so the compositional scale and accompanying motifs differ greatly.
